title: Look E design package: naming review, pilot Character Bible, reference sheets, card mock-ups and mobile specifications (design only)
problem: Owner approved Look E for design only and asked for a design package for separate approval before any implementation. Before that, the owner wants to rework character names and the naming style ("i dont like some names").
scope: Naming review first: every current name, title and quirk with flags, and naming-style options; the owner picks a style and the names to change; the result is recorded as a decision (no code or data change)
Character Bible v1.0 for the two pilots (Benny, Sailor Jia Wen, or their new names), including the walk-in figure rules they depend on
Corrected character reference sheets (front, three-quarter and side, six expressions, colour and prop call-outs) and image-generation prompts for an outside tool, which the owner runs and finishes
Kickstarter-quality card mock-up concepts: one customer card and one shopkeeper card (front and back), showing gameplay information first, as design mock-ups only

Mobile character adaptation specifications: sizes and screens where illustrated characters replace pixel ones, small-size readability, wearable compatibility for the 11 worn looks, performance and hidden-information rules
Present the whole package for a separate approval
exclusions: Implementing assets, changing game code or data, renaming characters in the game, or replacing existing artwork (the app, the print kit and the card backs stay as they are)
Changing game mechanics, customer information or hidden-information rules
Spending money or commissioning an illustrator
Generating images in this repo or presenting images that were not actually made

acceptance.text: Owner chooses a naming style and the names to change (exact words recorded)
acceptance.evidence: Owner chose all names: shopkeepers and guests (DEC-064) and customers (DEC-065), 2026-11-07, exact words recorded. Three customer names flagged for a yes or no.
